body:
Real, faithful PARENA-language port of src/main.c's own cmd_build:
build-file reads a real .prn file off disk, runs it through the
selfhost lexer->parser->region->emit pipeline (all 4 prior domains),
and writes real C to a real output file. First selfhost file to do
real disk I/O rather than work purely on in-memory strings.

Found and fixed 2 real bugs along the way (both confirmed live via gcc
errors): (1) node-kind-code/is-symbol?/is-symbol-headed-list?/
is-call-named? defined identically in both region.prn and emit.prn --
the same "private top-level names aren't module-scoped" gap join-all
hit earlier, never exercised for these 4 names until region.prn and
emit.prn were finally compiled together in one build. Fixed by
renaming emit.prn's own copies with an emit- prefix. (2) a match-bound
Ok payload of a real defstruct type, passed directly as a by-value
function argument, stays generic void* -- fixed with the same deref
convention already established for get-field, confirmed to apply to a
bare deref too.

7 real assertions in tests/test_selfhost_main.c, including a full
disk-to-disk run against examples/valid_only.prn, a real gcc
compile+link+run of the disk-written output against the same driver
domain 4 uses, and a real negative case (nonexistent input path fails
clean, no crash). Full local suite (336 tests) + all 4 prior selfhost
domains + real mingw cross-compile clean, zero regressions. Wired into
CI as a 5th, Linux-only step (same reason domain 4 stayed Linux-only).

NORTHSTAR.md updated with full design-departure and bug writeup.
PARENA commit 2249627. CI run 33085952519: all 4 jobs green (Bazel,
Windows, macOS, Tag & Release), confirmed via the Actions API, not
assumed.
